name: Quiz Solver
description: Detects quiz questions on the page and selects the answers using your knowledge base (offline algorithm) or any LLM.

manual-question.description: Manual: selected text is the question (starts a new question)

manual-answer.description: Manual: add selected text as an answer option

solve-quiz.description: Auto: detect + select answers on the page

undo-answers.description: Auto: roll back answers one step (undo)

redo-answers.description: Auto: redo (step forward in answer history)

reapply-answers.description: Auto: re-apply the last solved answers
